titleEn: AGRIVI AI Engage Named 2026 Agronomy Solution of the Year
titleZh: AGRIVI AI Engage荣获2026年度农艺解决方案奖
summaryZh: AGRIVI AI Engage被AgTech Breakthrough评为2026年度农艺解决方案。该方案通过AI Workforce模式，部署农业专用AI代理（如AI农艺师、AI销售代表等），在WhatsApp、Viber等渠道为农户提供本地语言咨询，扩展了农艺团队的服务能力。实际部署中，农场触达率提升3倍，约70%的新销售来自AI首次接触的农户，追加销售提升20%。该模式与AGRIVI 360 FMS等系统结合，构成农业数据与智能基础。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了AI代理在农业咨询和客户互动中的实际应用，其商业成果（3倍触达、70%新销售）对智慧畜牧行业探索AI赋能客户服务具有重要参考价值。
contentFull: !Image 2 !Image 3: Spinner: Black decorative ![Image 4: AGRIVI!Image 5: AGRIVI!Image 6: AGRIVI!Image 7: AGRIVI](https:www.agrivi.com) Products AGRIVI 360 FMS 360 Farm Enterprise 360 Agriculture Supply Chain 360 Traceability AGRIVI AI Engage Engage Inputs Engage Supply Chain Engage Public Sector Industries Farming Food & Beverages Retail Input Manufacturers Public Sector Resources ROI Calculator Farm Digitalization Score Blog News Case Studies eBooks Webinars Newsroom BOOK A MEETING ![Image 8English](https:www.agrivi.comnewsagrivi-ai-engage-agronomy-solution-of-the-year) ![Image 9Hrvatski](https:www.agrivi.comhr "Switch to Hrvatski") ![Image 11Français](https:www.agrivi.comfr "Switch to Français") ![Image 13Deutsch](https:www.agrivi.comde "Switch to Deutsch") ![Image 15Italiano](https:www.agrivi.comit "Switch to Italiano") ![Image 17Polski](https:www.agrivi.compl "Switch to Polski") ![Image 19Română](https:www.agrivi.comro "Switch to Română") ![Image 21Srpski](https:www.agrivi.comsr "Switch to Srpski") ![Image 23Español](https:www.agrivi.comes "Switch to Español") AGRIVI AI Engage Named 2026 Agronomy Solution of the Year HomeNewsCompanyAGRIVI AI Engage Named 2026 Agronomy Solution of the Year ![Image 25: AGRIVI AI Engage 2026 Agronomy Solution of the Year award announcement with the AgTech Breakthrough badge.](https:www.agrivi.comwp-contentuploads202608Web-article-cover-1.png) AGRIVI AI Engage Named 2026 Agronomy Solution of the Year By Barbara Busic |Company, News Comments are Closed|20 August, 2026 |0 AGRIVI AI Engage Award 2026 marks the recognition of AGRIVI AI Engage as the 2026 “Agronomy Solution of the Year” by AgTech Breakthrough. The award recognises an AI Workforce business model that gives agricultural organisations more capacity for advisory, farmer engagement, data collection and commercial follow-up. Key Takeaways–AI Engage AGRIVI AI Engage received the 2026 “Agronomy Solution of the Year” award in the Internet-of-Things and AI section. AGRIVI uses AI Engage to deploy agriculture-specific AI agents across agronomy, sales, supply chains, and public advisory. The AI Workforce business model adds capacity around existing teams, while people remain responsible for expert decisions and relationships. Selected deployments have reported 3x farm reach, approximately 70% of new sales originating from farmers first engaged through the AI agent, and 20% upsell uplift. AI Workforce sits within AGRIVI’s Agriculture Data and Intelligence Foundation alongside AGRIVI 360 FMS, external agricultural data, and enterprise systems. Why the AGRIVI AI Engage Award 2026 Matters The recognition matters because agronomy needs more than a general AI interface. Advice depends on crop context, timing, local conditions, product knowledge, and trusted expertise. For that reason, AI Engage works with a verified knowledge base prepared with the organisation that deploys it. Farmers can ask questions through WhatsApp, Viber or the web. They can also communicate in their local language. At the same time, the organisation stays behind the service. Agronomy, commercial and advisory teams keep responsibility for oversight and follow-up. Therefore, complex cases can move to the right person when expert judgement is needed. In practice, the model helps organisations make trusted knowledge available to more farmers. It also keeps farmer conversations connected to the teams responsible for the relationship. The AI advisory deployment guide explains the implementation model in more detail. What AI Engage Does AI Engage is the branded product through which AGRIVI deploys agriculture-specific AI agents. These agents can take on defined roles across the agri-food ecosystem. For agricultural input companies, an AI Agronomist can answer questions about crops, nutrition, crop protection, and product use. Meanwhile, an AI Sales Representative can support product communication and identify commercial interest. Relevant conversations can then move to sales or agronomy teams. For food companies, an AI Supply Chain Manager can support regular communication with growers and suppliers. In addition, it can collect field information and support sourcing workflows that otherwise require many calls, messages and manual checks. For ministries, public institutions and development organisations, an AI Public Advisory Agent can extend agricultural guidance to larger farmer populations. As a result, access to advice depends less on the number of available human advisors. These roles use the same business model. The organisation gains additional capacity, while its people remain responsible for specialist decisions and relationships. How AI Workforce Adds Capacity The capacity problem is practical. One agronomist, salesperson or procurement specialist can work effectively with only a limited number of farmers. However, many organisations need regular contact with thousands or tens of thousands of farms. The challenge grows when communication must continue throughout the season. AI Engage adds the capacity that is missing. For example, a farmer may need nutrition advice today and crop protection guidance next week. Later, the same farmer may ask about a product or need specialist support. Meanwhile, a food company may need frequent updates from hundreds of suppliers. AI agents add a working layer around those teams. They can handle recurring interactions, provide access to approved knowledge, and collect information continuously. When a case needs human judgement, the conversation can move to the appropriate expert. Therefore, teams can spend more time on work where expertise, relationships or decisions matter most. AGRIVI also manages the operational layer around the service. This includes setup, knowledge-base configuration and verification, channel implementation, launch, monitoring and ongoing improvement. Consequently, organisations can introduce the model without first building a separate AI platform or a new internal technical team. The current product overview provides more detail on the AI Engage offer. Agriculture Data and Intelligence Foundation AI Workforce is one layer of AGRIVI’s broader Agriculture Data and Intelligence Foundation. The architecture connects agricultural records, operational workflows, intelligence, and action. AGRIVI 360 FMS provides the system of record and system of action for farm and field operations. It brings together farm and field records, farm economics, planning, operations management, monitoring, insights, compliance, sustainability, traceability, reporting, and intelligence. Meanwhile, the AI Workforce layer adds farmer engagement, 247 advisory, AI data collection and intelligence. Defined AI agent roles extend capacity around the people and teams using that foundation. The architecture can also connect external agricultural data sources. These include weather stations, farm sensors, satellite imagery, drone imagery and pest traps. In addition, AGRIVI can connect with ERP and other enterprise systems. Together, these layers strengthen the link between what happens in agriculture and what organisations do next. !Image 26: AGRIVI Agriculture Data and Intelligence Foundation showing AGRIVI AI Workforce with AI Agronomist, AI Sales Representative, AI Supply Chain Manager and AI Public Advisory Agent roles, AGRIVI 360 FMS, connected agricultural data sources and enterprise systems. AGRIVI AI Engage Award 2026: Commercial Proof AGRIVI AI Engage Award 2026: Commercial proof is visible in selected deployments. AGRIVI clients using AI Engage have reported 3x farm reach. Approximately 70% of new sales originated from farmers first engaged through the AI agent. The same deployments reported 20% upsell uplift. These results matter because they connect the AI channel with farmer reach and commercial behaviour. By contrast, conversation volume alone does not show whether the model creates business value. Instead, organisations can measure whether they reach more farmers, identify qualified interest and connect relevant conversations with commercial or agronomy teams. The AI advisory ROI framework sets out a broader measurement approach. Therefore, the results provide useful context for the award. More importantly, they show how additional advisory capacity can translate into measurable outcomes. !Image 28: Selected AGRIVI AI Engage deployments have reported 3x farm reach, approximately 70% of new sales originating from farmers first engaged through the AI agent, and 20% upsell uplift. “AGRIVI AI Engage meets farmers through the channels they already use, and the business results validate the business model. Clients using our solution have achieved three times the farm reach within existing sales territories, with approximately 70% of new sales originating from farmers first engaged through the AI agent, alongside a 20% uplift in upsell performance. We are grateful to AgTech Breakthrough for this recognition. Our mission is to support the agri-food industry with digital solutions that contribute to sustainable and profitable food production. AGRIVI AI Engage gives our clients a proven path to creating value at farm level through a channel farmers already use. That is the difference.” Matija Zulj, CEO of AGRIVI Recognition Across the 2026 AgTech Awards AGRIVI received the award in the Internet-of-Things and AI section of the AgTech Breakthrough Awards. The organiser’s 2026 winners list also includes major agriculture companies and specialist AgTech businesses. Corteva Agriscience, Kubota Tractor Corporation, Netafim and Reinke Manufacturing are among the recognised companies. Inari, Saga Robotics, AgZen and Intelinair also appear in the 2026 programme. In addition, AgTech Breakthrough states that its published judging process assesses Innovation, Performance, Ease of Use, Functionality, Value and Impact. The organiser selects one winner for each award. This wider context shows the range of technologies represented in the programme. Ho
translationZh:
AGRIVI AI Engage荣获2026年度农艺解决方案奖，这一奖项由AgTech Breakthrough颁发，旨在表彰其AI Workforce商业模式，该模式为农业组织提供了更多的咨询、农户互动、数据收集和商业跟进能力。

**关键要点**

AGRIVI AI Engage在物联网和人工智能类别中荣获2026年度农艺解决方案奖。AGRIVI利用AI Engage在农艺、销售、供应链和公共咨询领域部署农业专用AI代理。AI Workforce商业模式在现有团队基础上增加产能，而人员仍负责专家决策和客户关系。部分部署报告显示，农场触达率提升3倍，约70%的新销售来自首次通过AI代理接触的农户，追加销售提升20%。AI Workforce是AGRIVI农业数据与智能基础的一部分，与AGRIVI 360 FMS、外部农业数据和企业系统协同工作。

**为什么AGRIVI AI Engage 2026奖项很重要**

这一认可很重要，因为农艺需要的不只是通用AI界面。建议依赖于作物背景、时机、当地条件、产品知识和可信赖的专业知识。因此，AI Engage使用与部署组织共同准备的经过验证的知识库。农民可以通过WhatsApp、Viber或网页提问，还可以使用当地语言交流。同时，组织保持对服务的支持。农艺、商业和咨询团队继续负责监督和跟进。因此，复杂案例可以在需要专家判断时转给合适的人员。在实践中，该模式帮助组织将可信知识传递给更多农民，同时保持农民对话与负责关系的团队相连。AI咨询部署指南更详细地解释了实施模式。

**AI Engage的功能**

AI Engage是AGRIVI部署农业专用AI代理的品牌产品。这些代理可以在农业食品生态系统中承担特定角色。对于农业投入品公司，AI农艺师可以回答有关作物、营养、植保和产品使用的问题。同时，AI销售代表可以支持产品沟通并识别商业兴趣。相关对话随后可以转给销售或农艺团队。对于食品公司，AI供应链经理可以支持与种植者和供应商的定期沟通，收集田间信息并支持采购流程，否则需要大量电话、消息和人工检查。对于部委、公共机构和发展组织，AI公共咨询代理可以将农业指导扩展到更多农民群体。因此，获取建议不再受限于可用人工顾问的数量。这些角色使用相同的商业模式：组织获得额外产能，而人员仍负责专家决策和关系。

**AI Workforce如何增加产能**

产能问题很实际。一名农艺师、销售人员或采购专家只能有效服务有限数量的农民。然而，许多组织需要与数千或数万个农场保持定期联系。当沟通必须贯穿整个季节时，挑战更大。AI Engage增加了缺失的产能。例如，农民今天可能需要营养建议，下周需要植保指导。之后，同一农民可能询问产品信息或需要专家支持。同时，食品公司可能需要数百个供应商的频繁更新。AI代理在这些团队周围增加了工作层。它们可以处理重复性互动，提供经批准的知识，并持续收集信息。当案例需要人工判断时，对话可以转给适当的专家。因此，团队可以花更多时间在专业知识、关系或决策最重要的工作上。AGRIVI还管理服务周围的运营层，包括设置、知识库配置和验证、渠道实施、启动、监控和持续改进。因此，组织无需先构建单独的AI平台或新的内部技术团队即可引入该模式。当前产品概述提供了更多关于AI Engage产品的详细信息。

**农业数据与智能基础**

AI Workforce是AGRIVI更广泛的农业数据与智能基础的一部分。该架构连接农业记录、运营工作流、智能和行动。AGRIVI 360 FMS提供农场和田间运营的记录系统和行动系统，汇集农场和田间记录、农场经济、规划、运营管理、监控、洞察、合规、可持续性、可追溯性、报告和智能。同时，AI Workforce层增加了农民互动、24/7咨询、AI数据收集和智能。定义的AI代理角色扩展了使用该基础的人员和团队的能力。该架构还可以连接外部农业数据源，包括气象站、农场传感器、卫星图像、无人机图像和害虫诱捕器。此外，AGRIVI还可以与ERP和其他企业系统连接。这些层共同加强了农业实际发生的情况与组织下一步行动之间的联系。

**AGRIVI AI Engage 2026奖项：商业证明**

AGRIVI AI Engage 2026奖项的商业证明在部分部署中可见。使用AI Engage的AGRIVI客户报告农场触达率提升3倍，约70%的新销售来自首次通过AI代理接触的农户，追加销售提升20%。这些结果很重要，因为它们将AI渠道与农民触达和商业行为联系起来。相比之下，仅对话量并不能显示该模式是否创造商业价值。相反，组织可以衡量他们是否触达更多农民、识别合格兴趣并将相关对话与商业或农艺团队连接。AI咨询ROI框架提供了更广泛的衡量方法。因此，这些结果为奖项提供了有用的背景。更重要的是，它们显示了额外咨询产能如何转化为可衡量的结果。

“AGRIVI AI Engage通过农民已经使用的渠道与他们接触，商业结果验证了商业模式。使用我们解决方案的客户在现有销售区域内实现了三倍的农场触达，约70%的新销售来自首次通过AI代理接触的农户，追加销售提升20%。我们感谢AgTech Breakthrough的认可。我们的使命是通过数字解决方案支持农业食品行业，促进可持续和盈利的食品生产。AGRIVI AI Engage为我们的客户提供了一条经过验证的途径，通过农民已经使用的渠道在农场层面创造价值。这就是区别。”AGRIVI首席执行官Matija Zulj表示。

**2026年AgTech奖项中的认可**

AGRIVI在AgTech Breakthrough Awards的物联网和人工智能类别中获奖。组织者的2026年获奖者名单还包括主要农业公司和专业AgTech企业。Corteva Agriscience、Kubota Tractor Corporation、Netafim和Reinke Manufacturing等公司均在其中。Inari、Saga Robotics、AgZen和Intelinair也出现在2026年计划中。此外，AgTech Breakthrough表示，其公布的评审过程评估创新、性能、易用性、功能性、价值和影响。组织者为每个奖项选择一个获胜者。这一更广泛的背景显示了该计划所代表的技术范围。
